title: silk orchid
text: silk orchid. My 80 year old mom loves orchids but.. it's sad when they are done.  So she asked for a silk one.  I found this one.  She received it and is THRILLED.  Reporting that it looks so real.  And I just have to note that my Mom is very picky.  So that says a lot.  Thinking about buying one for myself because she was so happy
